verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is itself the AI agent. The docs describe delegating complex multi-step work to it and getting structured results back, across a broad documented capability set: web browsing, a sandboxed code VM, document creation, email and calendar, and 400+ connectors. Delegated tasks include human-in-the-loop approvals and clarifying questions, and community users confirm a 'Computer' option in the perplexity.ai sidebar. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-app (non-MCP) delegation experience, and independent hands-on reports of tasks completing successfully.
